title: Quick Test
description: Choose a task and enter its connection and inputs. No model, channel, or Plan setup is required.
error: Quick Test is unavailable; check local logs
keyNote: The API Key is used only for this test and enters the Core credential flow only after you confirm saving.
manual: Enter address and API Key manually
filled: Filled the address from {{name}}; Core securely reads the saved API Key.
chooseChannel: Choose an enabled channel to fill automatically, or paste values manually.
noChannel: No enabled channel is available for Quick Test; enter the connection manually.
fullUrlHint: Requests the address exactly as entered
timeoutHint: Defaults to 30 seconds; Core returns end-to-end timing.
resultHint: Shows only stable diagnostics, timing, and counts—not response content or internal errors.
waitingHint: Enter connection details and send a test to see connectivity, HTTP status, and latency.

model.label: Model ID
model.placeholder: Choose a catalog model or enter one
model.empty: No matching model; keep the current input
model.matched: Matched catalog model {{name}}; saving will reuse it.
model.ambiguous: Multiple catalog models share this name, so automatic reuse is unavailable. Enter a unique upstream model ID.
model.choose: Choose an existing OpenAI model or enter an upstream model ID.
model.none: The catalog has no OpenAI models; enter an upstream model ID.

resultPanel.successHint: The endpoint completed a valid model request.
resultPanel.failedHint: Use the stable classification to check the address, credential, or upstream service.
resultPanel.savedChannel: This connection comes from a saved channel.

performance.title: Quick performance test
performance.description: Run a streaming workload with the current connection. Reports are archived after requests are executed.
performance.needTarget: Enter a request count or duration
performance.invalid: Performance-test parameters are out of range
performance.error: Quick performance test is unavailable; check local logs
performance.formHint: When both count and duration are set, sending stops when either target is reached. Output tokens are a request limit, not a generation guarantee.
performance.runningHint: Core creates the aggregate report after requests finish.
performance.completeWithFailures: Performance test complete with failed requests
performance.passedHint: All requests completed and passed protocol and semantic validation.
performance.failedHint: The report contains only aggregate metrics and stable error classifications.
performance.notArchived: Performance results were generated but could not be written to the report catalog.

errorCode.network_error: Unable to connect to the endpoint
errorCode.semantic_empty: Endpoint returned no valid model content
errorCode.response_too_large: Endpoint response exceeded the safety limit

save.title: Save connection
save.error: Unable to save the connection; check local logs
save.reuse: Reuse catalog model {{name}} and create a channel and mapping.
save.create: Core will create a model, channel, and mapping. Existing names or connections are rejected to avoid overwriting.
save.keyHidden: The API Key is never shown in this preview.

task.valueRequired: Enter a value of the required type.
task.invalidHistory: Invalid quick test history. Refresh and try again.
task.label: Test task
task.emptyHint: Add quick_test metadata to a Suite to make it available here.
task.noHistory: Successful and failed tests will appear here.
task.refreshFailed: The test started, but progress could not be refreshed. Refresh progress without starting again.
task.draftNote: Inputs are kept as a draft. Temporary API keys stay in this session; after running, you can explicitly remember the key.
task.historyVersion: Historical task revision and inputs restored. Edit them to run again.
task.missingChannel: The original channel is unavailable. Choose another channel or enter a temporary connection.
task.endpointHint: The task defines the request path. Enter the service Base URL.
task.performanceUnavailable: This task uses a separate video execution flow.
task.performanceHint: Run a text streaming performance test with the current connection.
task.failure: Operation failed. Check the connection or local logs.
task.rememberedKey: The key is stored in the system credential store and is never displayed.

task.forgetFailed: Could not remove the remembered key. Check the system credential store and retry.
